transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1416 Lerwick Drive?
Yeah, this is 1416 Lerwick Drive, just me and four others here, no water in yet, and we’re all good to stay put—no need for any truck or boat help, we’re fine!
Thanks for confirming you’re all safe and staying put. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
There’s five of us here total, and everyone’s able to stay put—no one’s stuck or can’t come to the phone, and the water’s not even inside yet, so we’re good.

Thanks for letting us know you’re all safe and accounted for. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
Nope, everyone’s good to go—no one’s stuck or needs special help, not even a wheelchair or oxygen, and definitely no motorized chair here.
Everyone’s good to go—no one needs special help. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside at all, just us five folks hanging tight, no one needs special help, and we’re all good to go—no need for a truck or boat or anything, we’re totally fine here.
Thanks for letting us know you’re all well and safe. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
Nope, no truck, no boat, and we’re all good—no free seats either, but we’re safe and everyone’s here, no one’s stuck or needing a ride out.
Thanks for checking in, everyone’s accounted for. Let me read that back: 5 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yeah, that’s right—five of us here, no water in yet, and we’re all good, no one needs to leave alone, and we don’t have any truck or boat or seats to help with, but we’re fine!
Thanks for confirming everyone’s safe and accounted for. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
